bm_desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, please find enclosed herewith the copy of the newspaper advertisement(s) pertaining to financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

The Board of Directors at its meeting held today viz. August 6, 2026 has approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. A copy of the said results along with the limited review report, is enclosed.
